state.paragraph: On December 13, 2014, the board met in person, together with the members of management and representatives of J.P. Morgan and Wachtell Lipton, to discuss and review the final bids and to consider the proposed transaction. Representatives of J.P. Morgan reviewed the respective bids as well as the recent progression of the sale process. Representatives of Wachtell Lipton reviewed the terms of the draft merger agreement and other transaction documents and reviewed the financing commitments that had been provided by the Buyer Group. Representatives of J.P. Morgan made a financial presentation concerning the proposed transaction with the Buyer Group, as well as the Company's alternatives to a sale of the Company, including a leveraged share repurchase. J.P. Morgan then rendered its oral opinion, which was subsequently confirmed in writing, to the board that, as of that date, and based upon and subject to the factors, assumptions and limitations set forth in its opinion, the merger consideration of $83.00 in cash to be paid to the holders of the Company's common stock in the merger was fair, from a financial point of view, to such holders. Following extensive discussion, the board unanimously determined that the merger agreement and the transactions contemplated thereby, including the merger, were advisable and in the best interests of PetSmart and its stockholders, and to recommend that the Company's stockholders approve the adoption of the merger agreement. The board's determination was subject, however, to confirmation that the remaining open points in the merger agreement had been satisfactorily resolved, and the board determined to reconvene, if deemed necessary by the ad hoc committee or the chairman of the board.
state.target_sentence: Following extensive discussion, the board unanimously determined that the merger agreement and the transactions contemplated thereby, including the merger, were advisable and in the best interests of PetSmart and its stockholders, and to recommend that the Company's stockholders approve the adoption of the merger agreement.

criteria.row_32: 12/10/2014 | PetSmart | Deadline | Final-bid due date (evening). Two written bids received; Bidder 3 gave only a verbal valuation.
criteria.row_33: 12/10/2014 | Bidder 3 | Did not submit | Verbal valuation not above the ~$78 stock price; J.P. Morgan said it was unlikely to be competitive, so no written offer. Both sides contributed. Not mentioned again.
criteria.row_34: 12/10/2014 | PetSmart (ad hoc committee) | Deadline revised | Neither bid acceptable unless improved: J.P. Morgan told both bidders to raise their bids, improved bids due 12/12. Treated as an extension within the final round, not a new round.
criteria.row_35: 12/12/2014 (early) | Buyer Group / Longview | Other material event | Rollover permitted: committee approved Buyer Group’s request to work with Longview; confidentiality agreement shared bid price. criteria.row_36: 12/12/2014 (evening) | Bidder 2 | Bid | price 81.5 | Revises #30. Confirmed to J.P. Morgan as best and final; with revised merger agreement drafts and financing commitment documents.
criteria.row_37: 12/12/2014 (evening) | Buyer Group | Bid | price 82.5 | Revises #29. Oral offer; said it was working to raise it within hours. Financing commitments already provided.

criteria.row_40: 12/13/2014 | Buyer Group | Other material event | Board selected Buyer Group: approved merger at $83.00 cash, subject to resolving remaining open points in the agreement; J.P. Morgan gave fairness opinion.
criteria.row_42: 12/14/2014 | Buyer Group | Merger agreement signed | $83.00 per share in cash. Parent Argos Holdings (BC Partners-affiliated). Equity up to $1.83bn plus Longview rollover (3,012,050 shares, $250m); debt up to $6.95bn (Citi-led); Longview voting agreement. No go-shop.
criteria.row_44: 12/14/2014 | PetSmart | Merger announced | Press release announcing the transaction on the signing date.
criteria.none: None of the ledger rows records the event reported in the target sentence, either as the row's own event or in its note.
criteria.not_an_event: The target sentence reports no discrete event of these kinds (background, reasoning, description or discussion only).

match.instructions: `target_sentence` (from a merger filing; `paragraph` gives context) appears to report that a voting, support or rollover agreement, a special committee, or the merger agreement itself is formed, approved or signed. Each option describes one row of a research ledger as date | party | event | note. Select the row that records the event reported in `target_sentence`: same party or group, same action, consistent date and terms, allowing paraphrase and allowing the event to be summarised in a row's note. A related event with a different party, date or action does not count.
